steps.title: Define Project Metadata
steps.description: Configure the application name and unified package identifier.

steps.title: Establish API Schema
steps.description: Create the API schema indicating local calculations with no online backend requirements.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Script
steps.description: Define build parameters, target SDK version 34, namespace and compiler compliance options.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest
steps.description: Establish the application structure, icon configurations, main launcher activity, and layout orientation controls.

steps.title: Define Color Palette
steps.description: Design a modern dark palette containing specific hex values for button categories (numeric, operators, helper actions).

steps.title: Create Button Background Drawables
steps.description: Implement modern rounded corner button shapes with selector states for interactive visual feedback.

steps.title: Develop User Interface Layout
steps.description: Implement a full-screen modern layout with a formula and result viewer pane, and a dynamic grids-of-keys layout using flexible weights.

steps.title: Implement Expression Parser Engine
steps.description: Develop a local recursive descent parser in MainActivity to calculate inputs offline safely according to mathematical precedence.

steps.title: Implement UI Event Handlers
steps.description: Wire up button interactions, expression construction logic, delete character routines, and safety checks in MainActivity.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Synthesize all XML resource files and native Java modules to complete compilation of the calculator.
